name: Git for Windows
origin: Git for Windows' own release file of its stable release v2.56.0.windows.2 (published 2026-10-05). `sha256` and `size` are what GitHub publishes for the asset (`gh release view v2.56.0.windows.2 --repo git-for-windows/git --json assets`: digest sha256:16ca394b…), and the same SHA-256 is in the release notes' own table. The file was downloaded on 2026-10-18 with `gh release download` and both were computed from it and found equal. `tree` and `key` were computed from that download, read by lib/git-bash/bzip2.js and unpacked with `skip` left out: `tree` is every file there, its count, its bytes, and the SHA-256 over one line `path NUL size NUL sha256 LF` per file in path order (install.js treeDigest); `key` is each file SynaBun starts, with its size and SHA-256; `folders` are the tree's empty folders (an installer of files carries none, so the Windows installer makes them).
